verdict.rationale: ADP's first-party pages say payroll taxes are "calculated, filed and paid for you." They also say ADP handles tax filing for employees working across multiple state or local jurisdictions in one pay period, and that it pays any fines from its own filing errors. State unemployment insurance management and W-2/1099 e-filing are also listed, though W-2/1099 forms cost extra. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of automated filing and remittance, and detailed documentation of jurisdiction coverage and remittance mechanics beyond marketing copy.
